QuakeDock.description: Cross-platform installer and launcher for Quake and QuakeWorld: set up campaign and multiplayer with vkQuake and ezQuake on Windows, Linux or macOS.

ArenaHub.description: Installer and launcher for Quake III Arena: your Steam copy, the Quake3e engine, classic mods (CPMA, OSP, Rocket Arena 3, Threewave CTF) and 47 map packs.

PyVideoKit.description: FFmpeg-based video toolkit: trim, concatenate, fade, VHS effect, lossless FFV1 masters and 4K ProRes exports for YouTube. Installs the library, the CLI and the GUI.

PyVideoKit-CLI.description: Command-line interface for PyVideoKit: every tool from a single pvk command, with Rich progress bars.

PyVideoKit-GUI.description: PySide6 desktop app for PyVideoKit: tabs, drag-and-drop, batch processing, and per-file and overall progress.

PyVideoKit-Libs.description: Core library behind PyVideoKit, with zero Python dependencies: drives FFmpeg, FFprobe and SoX with progress callbacks.

VHSify.description: Turn any video into a worn-out VHS tape: chroma bleed, grain, tracking jitter and tape hiss. FFmpeg and SoX scripts for GNU/Linux, macOS and Windows.

WinJitsu.description: Animated window snapping for Linux X11: glide the active window to halves, quarters, center or fullscreen, and across monitors, from your hotkeys.

KlondikeCLI.description: Klondike solitaire for the terminal in C+⁠+17: seeded deals, draw one or three, move counter and scoring. Originally a 2016 university project.

MyReisinLapTimes.description: Windows desktop app to log lap times with photos and tire type, rank them in leaderboards and export shareable Top 10 images.

hide-scrollbar-youtube-firefox.description: Firefox add-on that hides the scrollbar on YouTube video pages so the player uses the full window width. No permissions, no data collection.

swift-livery-catalog.description: Official website for Suifuto Remon, a Suzuki Swift Sport ZC33S automotive project: a visual catalogue of vinyl livery designs.

echora-web.description: Web client for Echora: browse your music library and stream your own collection from a self-hosted server, with React and TypeScript.
